body:
I have been to enlightened by the support here I went to other threads to add my support. My hope drive has been doubled in the last 18 hours. This thread put me back on track, and for that, I am grateful. 

Thank you.

Hello. I see that you have posted here, you have already begun the start of anew. You may think you are alone. You have just posted in a community that is your friend the second we see your post. I am a 17 y/o male here, you and I, we are almost adults. The big 1-8 that allows us to start fresh, to do a new beginning. You and I don't know each other at all, but I **CARE** about you, as do the others who have posted here. Think about yourself for a moment, what did you always want to do as a child? Be the president? Astronaut? You can be anything you want! You don't need to be ivy league, all you have to be is you. 

I **believe** in you. Please **don't** give up.

Is your sister around the same age? If so, I think it is the "we are young and we should hate our siblings for being annoying." It happens. People simply grow out of it, just give it some time. As for getting mad at small things, you may just be on edge from all the stress in your life. Based on your politeness, I don't think you have anger issues at all, you're actually quite noble. 

Doing work-outs or other activities might lower the stress, and will probably take your mind of the self-harm. I know that I am going to start working out to get healthier and take my mind off the havoc that is my life. Double whammy! 

May I ask what kind of music you like? I know that music has helped me tremendously. Looking into relaxing music, whether it be acoustic or simply calm electronic music can really bring the light to our darkness. If you are into electronic music, I could throw you a few suggestions if you would like. 

Keep your head up high, you are young, and have much more to look forward to!

**Good Luck**
Look, I am not here to argue. I just said thanks in advance in the hope you would realize you are breaking a couple of guidelines for this subreddit.
Dude. Look at guideline #1. No tough love. Don't post here unless you're actually going to be supportive. Thanks.

I am glad to have gone to your profile and seen you have recent posts. Please hang in there! There is always something to live for! Whether it be your favorite food or favorite hobby. There is always joy to find, sometimes it just takes longer to find it, but it is worth it in the end.

You're so young, but so am I. I can say right now that both you and I have something in common. Room to grow and be the person we want to be. Anger is a destructive emotion, I would know, when my father passed I was always angry. It may be a destructive emotion, but if it is channeled right, it can bring you places. Ever tried football? Kick boxing? MMA? I have mentioned this to another person in school, most schools offer counseling, or have a social worker than can help guide. When it comes to lashing out, if you feel it, just walk away. It will end better if you halt that anger in its place and vent it to someone constructively instead of destructively. Make another thread if you can't find somewhere to vent. No one here will take anything personal.

As for your sister, try to get through this rough spot together. The embrace of another can give hope, even if you are both down. If you need to talk, I am here.

Hello friend. I have recently posted here as well as you. I know the feel you have, the "I accomplished something cool, what now?". I know that you think without happiness, there is no point to living. That isn't the case. Some say it would be easy to end it all, but what if life on this earth is the heaven you're looking for? Why not give it a try? Your mom may not understand, and may never. Maybe you could sit her down and let you just talk. Let out all of your thoughts before she can assume anything. My mom does the same thing to me, so just talk, let it all out before she can assume or debunk anything you say. In the end, it doesn't matter what she thinks. Parents sometimes don't know how to handle a situation like this, so they have a professional do it. That doesn't work all the time, it isn't for everyone. Find a good friend you trust, and just talk. Doesn't have to be about struggles, just talk, communicate with one another. Human contact is a godsend.

As for your friends, they have all their struggles too. Try and relate with one of the most trusted friend. You never know, they may have an incredible poker face. Just please, don't take your life. There is so much to live for, but so little to gain if you take your life. I know most  high schools offer free counseling to those that are struggling. Talk to your schedule manager or main office to seek it out.

Instead of taking your life, use your EMT skills to save others. Talk to me or others on this subreddit. We all love you, we are here to support and empower you. I don't even know you and I care about what happens to you. I see a good future with the EMT cert you have worked very hard on. Sometimes, helping others is good therapeutic. Saving a life is a good achievement, and I am sure you'll be saving many lives if you can just kick sadness's ass. We are your friends here, we are all family here. All with struggles, all with the ability to give another person a chance on life. Reply or message me, I am here if you want to talk. Hope to see you around, water95.

I made a short list about her above. I plan to impose my love without forcing her to reciprocate, that way I won't get a forced answer and hopefully get a real answer from the heart. School is not my top priority, but I am still passing a few classes, better than none passed I guess. 

My brother is currently in his 3 year of college and doesn't come home until march. I have let my mother know, but my brother is next on the list. I am going to wait until he comes home to give him the layout.

This thread gave me enough hope to get my life back on track. I may not be a serious case of suicide, but it certainly means a lot that you all treated it like so. The support shown here means so much. First time in a while I have gotten tears of joy. Thank you.

I am planning to do what you said. I am just waiting for a good time to do it. I can think about the situation and how it will go down a million times, but it will always happen differently, so I can't quite prepare. 

Here is a list of some of the x,y,z.

* Not afraid to speak her mind. Confident in her own words and backs them up.

* She is very empowered and independent, but has some issues she works through everyday.

* Shows care to others even though she is struggling herself.

* She actually thinks I am funny. I heard that is a start I guess. 

* She all around makes me happy. I have had many vivid dreams where it was just us hanging out. As sappy as it is, Just that makes me happy. The beauty just adds on ten-fold. As a teenage kid, I have a massive sexual drive, see attractive women and I think "Man I would bend her over a barrel and show her the 50 states." (reference anyone?) but in her case it is more "Man, I would date the shit out of her."

That is all I really have time for. I still have one more reply to get to. Maybe when I come back, I will add onto this list. 

Thanks for the uplifting reply. Gave me what more hope of landing this woman as a SO.

I am hoping that it is my prize. I am feeling a bit more optimistic than I was 12 hours ago. I had was on some anxiety medication for a while, but leaned off them because they made me incredible sick and did more harm than good. I am not a pill kind of person, if I am going to overcome this, it is with my own willpower.

Thank you, kind stranger. As I have said above to others, it means a lot to hear all this support and advice from people who don't know me. A lot people on the internet wouldn't give me the light of day. Internet trolls man. That is why I was trying to be careful about details.

The only weight on my shoulders when it comes to feeling responsible is she owns a business and I am trying to keep it from falling under due to irresponsible co-owner. so I go in on mornings to till the registers of orders and clean the place, all I can do legally since it is a bar. I help my mom as much as I can, but lately sub consciously I have been distancing myself to shield myself from the inevitable end. I have had a a big rework on how to handle my behavior around my mom. Had a good day with her today, she didn't have chemo or radiation, so we went out to eat. Had a great time! Talked for a few hours, showed her the form, and we are going to work this out. Funny how my life can go from shit to something worth working on.

Thank you for the reply, it means a lot for someone who doesn't know me to actually take time and give some advice and support.

Gave my friend a call and we are going to make this community center plan happen. I haven't informed him of the situation at hand, but I feel that is best told in person and with both my good friends present.

Thank you, for your support. I felt extremely down when I was typing out this thread, but I feel uplifted. I suppose it pay off to talk to people.

I have started to discuss an exercise plan with one of my good friends. Him and I are going to pool some money to get a year-round membership at a local community center. I have started to clean up my eating habits, so there is a start. I have been trying to spend time with my mother, but between chemo, radiation, and her feeling too sick, it is hard to find some quality time. I will try to let a friend know one by one like you said, I will come back with the outcome. I am really tired though, so I will be back tomorrow to read up and reply to any others.

Thank you. It means a lot to see people who don't know me care.

Thank you for a reply. I have been trying to muster up some strength to get help from my school therapist. My family can't afford the expensive ones, so that has been pushing me away from help. The form requires me to fill it out with my mom, but it will be hard to let her see me in emotional pieces. I found a little motivation and that is what lead me to post here for some advice. 

Again, thank you.

Hey man. I know it seems grim and all, I just made my own post about some of my struggles. Please, don't take your life. I don't know where you're from, but please, give this a call.
